title: LangNCO: Compiling Natural-Language Constraints into Inference-Time Interventions for Neural Combinatorial Optimization
abstract: arXiv:2610.23190v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Neural combinatorial optimization (NCO) rapidly produces high-quality solutions for problem structures encountered during training, but operational requirements may change after deployment and be communicated in natural language. We propose LangNCO, a framework that compiles instance-specific requirements into structured inference-time interventions for a frozen NCO solver, without changing the pretrained policy's architecture, learned input representation, or parameters. A pretrained LLM serves as a replaceable semantic front end, translating each requirement into a schema-validated domain-specific language (DSL) rule set. A deterministic Rule Executor applies the rules as nonexpansive hard action masks. Because local masking prevents immediate violations but does not ensure that a complete feasible continuation remains reachable, Critical-Offset Decoding extracts rule-referenced critical nodes and reallocates part of a fixed rollout

translated_title: LangNCO：将自然语言约束编译为神经组合优化的推理时干预
translated_abstract: 神经组合优化（NCO）能够针对训练时遇到的问题结构快速生成高质量解，但运营需求可能在部署之后发生变化，并以自然语言的形式被传达。我们提出LangNCO，这是一个将实例特定需求编译为结构化推理时干预的框架，作用于被冻结的NCO求解器，无需改变预训练策略的架构、学习到的输入表示或参数。预训练的大语言模型（LLM）充当可替换的语义前端，将每条需求翻译为经过模式验证的领域特定语言（DSL）规则集。确定性的规则执行器将这些规则应用为非扩张的硬动作掩码。由于局部掩码虽然能够防止即时违规，却不能确保仍然存在一条完整可行的后续解路径，关键偏移解码会提取规则所引用的关键节点，并重新分配固定rollout的一部分（摘要在此处截断）。
tldr: LangNCO利用预训练大语言模型将自然语言运营需求编译为DSL规则，并通过硬动作掩码与关键偏移解码等推理时干预手段，在不改动冻结NCO求解器的架构、表示与参数的情况下满足部署后出现的新约束。
en_tdlr: LangNCO uses a pretrained LLM to compile natural-language operational requirements into DSL rules, enforced via inference-time interventions (hard action masks and Critical-Offset Decoding) on a frozen neural combinatorial optimization solver without altering its architecture, learned representations, or parameters.
